Check final-output truncation, cancellation and output-budget enforcement when stops in analysis are intentionally ignored (A-001, TB-007, T-010). The changed libs/mlx, libs/mlx-swift and libs/mlx-swift-lm pins at line 1 expose no dependency diffs; their native runtime, memory/lifecycle and cache effects cannot be assessed here. Integration must review those diffs, especially stop handling and preservation of T-041 scope/ownership guarantees. Missing implementation evidence is a coverage limit, not a finding or assurance of safety.
